sections.heading: Testing and license services
sections.markdown:
## Testing and license services

FACT_ID: sec03-F01 | anchor: A01
The handbook describes knowledge testing as a walk-in service at DDS centers; applicants must begin at least 30 minutes before closing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F02 | anchor: A01
Applicants needing reading or hearing assistance should contact a service center to arrange an oral examination or a hearing interpreter. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F03 | anchor: A01
Some road-rule examinations are offered in languages other than English, but the applicant still must understand the simple English used on road signs. Sign testing and the driving test are described as English-only. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F04 | anchor: A01
Do not bring writing tools, paper, phones, messaging devices or other wireless equipment into the knowledge-testing area. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F05 | anchor: A01
During knowledge testing, speak only with the administering examiner. Breaking the testing rules is misconduct and makes the session a failure. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F06 | anchor: A01
The Road Signs component requires at least 15 correct answers among its 20 questions. It covers recognition of road signs, signals and markers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F07 | anchor: A01
The Road Rules component separately requires at least 15 correct answers among its 20 questions, covering responsibilities, laws and safe practices for the license class. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F08 | anchor: A01
Road-skills testing requires an appointment, which the handbook directs applicants to arrange through DDS online services. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F09 | anchor: A01
A vehicle equipped with driver-assistance systems may be used for the test, but the applicant must show the ability to operate it without relying on that technology. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F10 | anchor: A01
For a Class C or D road test, the applicant supplies a four-wheel vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F11 | anchor: A01
The road-test vehicle needs valid registration and a plate. With a temporary dealer tag, the applicant must show purchase documentation within 30 days of purchase, or within 7 days for a third-party purchase. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F12 | anchor: A01
The road-test vehicle must have liability coverage, acceptable insurance or registration evidence showing its vehicle identification number, and pass a safety inspection. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F13 | anchor: A01
If the road-test vehicle lacks illuminated turn indicators, the applicant must be able to demonstrate the required hand signals. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F14 | anchor: A01
A rental vehicle may be used only when the contract permits testing, the applicant is a named driver, and valid vehicle insurance is documented. The rental contract must be provided for review. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F15 | anchor: A01
DDS does not conduct the road test when weather or another condition makes it unsafe for the examiner or applicant; affected appointments are to be rescheduled. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F16 | anchor: A01
For test parallel parking, center the vehicle between the standards and finish within 18 inches of the curb. The stated test space is 22 feet long and 10 feet deep. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F17 | anchor: A01
For the backing exercise, reverse approximately 50 feet smoothly and straight, at no more than 10 miles per hour, looking behind with the head turned and staying within the boundaries. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F18 | anchor: A01
At a test stop sign or signal, approach in the correct lane, signal appropriately, stop before the crosswalk, and remain stopped until pedestrians have cleared the side being traveled. Proceed only when safe. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F19 | anchor: A01
The road test includes turning the vehicle around in a confined space using a three-point turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F20 | anchor: A01
When testing in a manual-transmission vehicle, shift correctly and operate the clutch smoothly. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F21 | anchor: A01
Approach an intersection or corner in the proper lane and check both directions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F22 | anchor: A01
Yield during the test to pedestrians, bicyclists and other drivers already entering the intersection, stopping until they have cleared it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F23 | anchor: A01
Before a test turn, enter the appropriate lane and give the turn signal far enough in advance. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F24 | anchor: A01
The handbook describes a remotely examined road test with a dual-facing camera and hands-free phone. A licensed parent, guardian or responsible adult aged at least 21 rides as the passenger. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F25 | anchor: A01
In the traditional road-test arrangement, the examiner rides in the passenger seat. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec03-F26 | anchor: A02
Before passing during the road test, check ahead and behind to ensure the maneuver will not interfere with traffic. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=14]

FACT_ID: sec03-F27 | anchor: A02
Maintain enough following space to retain control if the vehicle ahead stops or turns abruptly. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=14]

FACT_ID: sec03-F28 | anchor: A02
During the road test, use both hands on the wheel, avoid resting an elbow on the window, and avoid unnecessary conversation with the examiner. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=14]

FACT_ID: sec03-F29 | anchor: A02
The Class C or D road-test passing score is at least 75 percent. At the end, the examiner can review the score sheet and discuss the result with the applicant. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=14]

FACT_ID: sec03-F30 | anchor: A02
Passing all required examinations results first in a temporary license or permit; the permanent document is sent by mail. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=14]

FACT_ID: sec03-F31 | anchor: A02
After the first failure of a Class C or D knowledge or road component, wait until the following day before repeating the failed portion. After a second or later failure, the waiting period is 7 days. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=14]

Misconceptions: A passing road-test percentage is not the same measure as the separate correct-answer threshold for either knowledge component.
Mnemonic: Prepare, demonstrate, review, then repeat only after the required wait.
Glossary: A certified driving history is the official record form offered through the stated in-person or mail route; an online downloaded copy is described separately.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Appointments, remote-testing arrangements, service eligibility, fees, document lists and administrative deadlines retain dated-source review.

corpus_stability.reason: Revision frequency and legal-currentness are not independently established; retain release hold while authoring the dated source-grounded candidate.

verification_debt.claim_text: The dated handbook facts retain source freshness, rights and independent factual-review debt; no current-law equivalence or live service/fee policy is certified.
Motorcycle, commercial and large noncommercial specialty-class testing is outside this regular Class C path.
Service-center hours and the source's claim about busiest visiting times are not verified current service availability.
Replacement price conflicts with earlier handbook prose; all replacement and driving-history fee amounts are withheld pending issuer reconciliation.

Voter registration, selective-service reporting, charitable donations and organ-donation medical statements are outside this driving-credential learning scope and are not authored as current legal or medical guidance.
Mailing destinations, phone numbers and exhaustive online-service availability were not verified as current; learners must use the issuer's current service instructions.
